name: Volcanoes
overview: Scripture portrays volcanic imagery as a powerful demonstration of God's sovereign presence and judgment. The burning mountain in Deuteronomy reveals God's holiness and awe-inspiring majesty, while the melting and smoking hills in Psalms and Judges illustrate His authority over creation. These vivid descriptions emphasize that the natural world responds to the touch of the Lord, reminding believers of His supreme power and divine control over the earth.
